summary: Build-system verification for react-native-google-mobile-ads@17.0.0 Kotlin nullability fix. Verified patch file, defensive fix-admob-kotlin.js script (idempotency + recovery), package.json postinstall wiring, node_modules .kt file state, and full yarn install run. All 8 requested checks passed. No runtime/API testing was performed as instructed (this was a Node.js-level filesystem/build-tooling test).
action_items: OPTIONAL: fix-admob-kotlin.js has a shebang (`#!/usr/bin/env node`) but is NOT chmod +x. This does not matter functionally because postinstall calls it via `node scripts/fix-admob-kotlin.js`, but if the intent was to allow direct execution, run `chmod +x scripts/fix-admob-kotlin.js`. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: fix-admob-kotlin.js is well-designed: idempotent, safe on missing file, safe on unexpected upstream change (skips gracefully), uses process.exit(0) on write failure so it never breaks the install pipeline.
The BAD/GOOD string constants in the script exactly match the two occurrences in the patch and in the current node_modules file — no drift.

postinstall order is correct: patch-package runs first, then the Node fallback verifies. If patch-package succeeds the fallback is a no-op; if patch-package silently fails (Windows edge case) the fallback still fixes the file.
